outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the closed drawer and aligns with its silver handle (frames 30–85, left_ego_image and wrist_image), closes its gripper around the handle (frames 86–100, wrist_image), and pulls the drawer outward, visibly exposing its interior (frames 107–125, image and left_ego_image). It releases the handle and withdraws, leaving the drawer open through frame 155 (image and left_ego_image). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
